newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products up - gasoline gains up to $5.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products up - gasoline gains up to $5.

text.p: NWE oil products were stronger on Tuesday, dealers said.

An early gasoline Eurograde barge deal at $236 for first half August followed by offers as high as $239 indicated another $5 surge, but gains were later pared back to around $3 as early August swap gains of $5 were eroded to $2.
Gas oil gained $3.50 a tonne as IPE futures caught up with gains made on Brent late on Monday.
High sulphur fuel barges gained $2 to trade at $95.50/$96 fob ARA due to prompt product shortage and loading delays at two storage sites.
Russian cracked cargoes remain strong with a deal reported at two means +$2.
